analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.statement: x and y lie on the positive real axis, where the principal square root is smooth and single-valued.

branch_conventions: sqrt denotes the nonnegative scalar square root on (0, infinity).

function_domains.sqrt: Unique positive scalar square root on (0, infinity), differentiable to the order required by the source expressions.

nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.statement: x and y are distinct, so y-x is nonzero.

nonzero_conditions.label: DERIVED
nonzero_conditions.statement: x, sqrt(x), and sqrt(x)+sqrt(y) are nonzero.

real_valued_functions: sqrt and its derivatives are real-valued on (0, infinity)
